reviewComments.text: Docs (README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/INSTALL.md) still only document `debug -V` / `--version`, not `-v`. The bug was `-v`; add `-v` to the version examples so users and scripts match the fixed behavior.

No automated regression for version flags (no CLI test file; smoke scripts do not assert `debug -v`). Consider a small check in scripts/smoke-report.mjs or a one-liner in package.json scripts that runs `node dist/cli.js -v` and expects exit 0 + semver output to prevent recurrence.

summary.bugSummary: `debug` / `debug-agent -v` failed with `error: unknown option '-v'` (exit 1). `-V` and `--version` worked and printed the package version.
summary.rootCause: In `src/cli.ts`, Commander's `.version()` was registered with flags `"-V, --version"` only. Commander allows one short flag per option, so lowercase `-v` was never registered and parse rejected it before any subcommand ran.
summary.fixExplanation: Register version as `-v, --version` via `.version(pkgVersion, "-v, --version", …)`, add a separate `-V` global option alias (same output/exit) because Commander cannot combine two short flags in one option, and add `"-v"` to `TOP_LEVEL_COMMANDS`. Post-review: document `-v` in README/AGENTS/INSTALL and add `npm run smoke:version` (`scripts/smoke-version.mjs`) to assert `-v`, `-V`, and `--version` return semver matching `package.json`.
risks: `-V` uses a manual `program.on('option:V')` handler alongside Commander's built-in version handler; future CLI refactors could drift behavior between `-v` and `-V` if not kept in sync.
Version string is read once at module load (`pkgVersion`); unusual installs with a moved or patched `package.json` after start would still show the load-time value.
followUps: Wire `npm run smoke:version` into CI or a combined smoke script so version regressions fail builds automatically.
Optionally extend smoke to cover `debug-agent` bin name when installed globally via `npm link` / npm global.
